features.name: add_location
features.title: Add a catalog location
features.description: Add a location to the Backstage Catalog, or validate it using dry-run mode.

type.description: Location type; defaults to url when omitted.

target.description: URL or path of the Catalog location target.

dryRun.description: Validate without registering the location when true.

onConflict.description: How to handle an existing location.

inputSchema.description: Register or validate a Backstage Catalog location.

data.description: Catalog result data, when the operation returns a value.

features.name: find_entities_by_name
features.title: Find entities by name
features.description: Find candidates by a substring of metadata.name or metadata.title; optionally restrict kind and namespace.

name.description: Entity name or title search term.

inputSchema.description: Find entities by name or title.

data.description: Catalog result data, when the operation returns a value.

features.name: find_users_by_name
features.title: Find users by name
features.description: Find User candidates by firstName, lastName, or both as case-insensitive displayName substrings. Returns all visible matches within lookup bounds; does not infer identity or name order.

firstName.description: User given-name fragment to match in displayName.

lastName.description: User family-name fragment to match in displayName.

name.description: One or both human-name fragments to search.

inputSchema.description: Find Users by given name, family name, or both.

data.description: Catalog result data, when the operation returns a value.
